package.name: livox_ros_driver2
package.description: Minimal vendored CustomMsg/CustomPoint so Point-LIO compiles. The Livox custom-message path is never used at runtime — the Go2 publishes a standard PointCloud2 and we run Point-LIO via the VELO16 path (see cloud_shim.py) — but Point-LIO includes livox_ros_driver2/msg/custom_msg.hpp unconditionally, so the type must exist at build time. Fields mirror the upstream driver.
